limitations: Synthetic forecasts, observations and alerts only: no weather model, no live weather service and no scoring of forecast accuracy.
One account per App instance; no shared household.
MCP only: no GUI, maps, radar or imagery.
The App clock moves only through Infra events; rainshadow.clock.advanced stands in for a platform clock.
Notices reach Mail only through an Infra-run sender and Messaging; the App itself delivers nothing.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
